title: Backend: Backtest Engine
description: Implement the core backtest engine in src/strategy_backtest/engine.py. Protocol-based pure engine that performs day-by-day simulation: calculate indicators -> evaluate rules -> generate signals -> T+1 trade execution -> equity tracking. Single position, long-only, configurable commission and slippage.

criteria: StrategyBacktestEngine class with run() method accepting DataFrame + config, returning BacktestResult with trades list, equity curve, and summary statistics
T+1 execution model: signal on day T, execute at T+1 open price (no look-ahead bias)
Single position constraint: cannot buy when already holding, cannot sell when no position
Commission calculation: commission = price * shares * commission_rate on both buy and sell
Slippage model: buy_price = open_price * (1 + slippage_rate), sell_price = open_price * (1 - slippage_rate)
Share calculation: shares = floor(available_cash * (1 - commission_rate) / buy_price / 100) * 100 (round to lot of 100)
Equity curve: daily equity = cash + position_shares * close_price
Summary statistics: total_return, max_drawdown, win_rate, trade_count, avg_holding_days
Max drawdown = max((peak - trough) / peak) across entire equity curve
Engine is pure: no DB access, no side effects, takes DataFrame returns BacktestResult dataclass
convergence.definition_of_done: Engine produces correct trades and statistics on synthetic data with known outcomes

files.change: Create StrategyBacktestEngine class with run method implementing T+1 simulation loop

implementation.title: Define data structures
implementation.description: Define BacktestConfig, Trade, EquityPoint, BacktestSummary, BacktestResult dataclasses for engine input/output

implementation.title: Implement main simulation loop
implementation.description: Iterate DataFrame day-by-day. On each day: check if holding position, evaluate buy/sell rules, queue signal for T+1 execution, execute pending orders at open price

implementation.title: Implement trade execution logic
implementation.description: Buy: calculate shares from available cash with commission, deduct cash, add position. Sell: calculate proceeds with commission, add cash, clear position. Apply slippage to execution prices.

implementation.title: Implement equity tracking
implementation.description: After each day's execution, record equity point: date, cash, position_value, total_equity, drawdown from peak

implementation.title: Implement summary statistics
implementation.description: After simulation completes, calculate total_return, max_drawdown, win_rate, trade_count, avg_holding_days from trades and equity data

implementation.title: Validate with synthetic data
implementation.description: Create test with known price series and simple rules (e.g., MA5 cross MA20), verify trade timing matches T+1 model and statistics are correct

reference.pattern: Protocol-based pure engine, no service/DB dependencies
reference.examples: Reference existing backtest_engine.py for simulation loop structure, but implement new engine independently

rationale.chosen_approach: Protocol-based pure engine (no DB/service dependencies) for maximum testability and reusability
decision_factors: Clarity (day-by-day loop is easy to debug)
rationale.tradeoffs: Day-by-day loop is slower than vectorized approach, but MVP performance is acceptable for daily data

risks.description: T+1 execution boundary may have off-by-one errors in signal vs execution dates
risks.mitigation: Extensive edge case testing with known-outcome synthetic data
risks.fallback: Add explicit date logging for signal and execution dates

risks.description: Rounding to lots of 100 shares may cause cash balance edge cases
risks.mitigation: Ensure share calculation uses floor division by 100, test with various price levels
